lark_e17_entry.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_entry.text: On Day One Hundred Eighteen, Lin bought a current ordinary assessment from her own earned purse before asking the practice room to receive her again. Its five copper did not consume the last reserved course assessment, which remained available for a later actual need. The clinician examined the recovered ankle after its week of accepted ground work and ordinary sleep. She permitted gradual lower limb effort inside the named current range, with changed gait, swelling or pain grounds to stop. The judgment concerned this present ordinary body. Duan would still need to assess the separate qi task.

lark_e17_entry_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_entry_002.text: Lin paid after that actual current assessment and kept its note with the ankle's earlier course. Her own purse could support the cost without borrowing an uncompleted future shift. The added five reduced what she would carry to the next road. It did not enlarge the course's forty assessment copper, promise another free check, or cure the older shoulder exclusion. She liked the clean current walk enough to resent how carefully the note still named the stop. A body could become usable again without its observer promising that every possible use was ready.

lark_e17_entry_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_entry_003.text: At the practice room, Duan asked her to cross the accepted ordinary distance before touching the board. He watched the lower turn and had her sit without hurry. Jiang's present isolated apparatus receiving was separate from the new carriage crossing. The small talisman lay on its ground bed, with its external release ready and no gallery load attached. Lin could identify the fitted support and ordinary room range herself. The preparation felt slower than beginning with the route she had missed. It also made the first question something the actual people in the room could answer.

lark_e17_entry_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_entry_004.text: The tenth formal meeting began with the established four pairs inside their current permitted task. Lin used the two established arm pairs without a sudden overhead movement, then the anterior and posterior lower limb pairs at the newly accepted small effort. Each short task reached its useful quarter within the fixed half input ceiling, four ordinary breaths and no more than an eighth per breath. She stopped and grounded before the next. The ordinary foot remained unchanged afterward. Duan accepted the present prior routes as usable here, not a claim that they could carry a new full mountain duty.

lark_e17_entry_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_entry_005.text: Only then did they return to the third upper limb primary pair, her unfinished fifth. Its two fixed references were familiar enough to invite a careless shortcut. Lin named both before moving qi and found the old second reference still pulling her attention toward the easier established arm route. Duan had her put the pointer down. The actual fifth would need its own connection and stopped useful task. Using the old pair well was not a substitute for opening the new one. She was impatient with the distinction until she felt her intention trying to make exactly that substitution.

lark_e17_entry_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_entry_006.text: The first renewed fifth pair attempt broke before its useful quarter. Lin stopped inside the existing ceiling, let the independent grounded release finish, and rested rather than supply another eager breath. The ankle and shoulder remained inside their current ordinary range. The interrupted route received its own current mark instead of inheriting a complete record from the established four. Duan accepted four copper for the actual formal meeting at its finish. Ten had now used forty of the eighty teaching scope, leaving ten meetings. The day's restored practice had not restored the result she wanted.

lark_e17_entry_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_entry_007.text: The practice keeper purchased another accepted two copper fuel pack for the isolated board, bringing its actual purchases to six of the twenty four reserved. Its measured external charge supported this received local apparatus work and was recorded separately from usable reserve in Lin's body. She could not count a paid pack as proof of forty eight recovered personal units. The sixth primary route, the lateral lower limb pair, remained unopened. The complete diagram had six names. The actual present body still supplied four established tasks and one interrupted beginning after ordinary recovery.

lark_e17_entry_008.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_entry_008.text: She completed her next accepted six hour low desk shift on Day One Hundred Nineteen. The received four copper brought her to twenty five completed shifts and one hundred earned copper in the course wage scope. Work used her present ordinary handling range, not the incomplete new pair. At the doorway, a basket repair trainee asked whether a good practice room needed every failed attempt hidden. Lin said it needed the right permission for each actual observer. She had been thinking the same question in the quiet intervals when nobody could see how much she wanted the fifth to hold.

lark_e17_observers_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_observers_001.text: The trainee was Wu Fang, an adult learning ordinary basket repairs under the market keeper. Tan Li, the association's adult desk apprentice, had asked a related question about how a public task could be described without claiming private body knowledge. Neither was qualified to operate the practice board or judge Lin's cultivation. They could attend a bounded unpowered comparison lesson if invited, and a later supervised preliminary trial from its accepted spectator position. Their ordinary jobs had their own hours. The invitation would give them no paid practice role or authority over a task they had merely watched.

lark_e17_observers_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_observers_002.text: Hu Lan offered three actual observation arrangements for the formal Day One Hundred Twenty Eight lesson and the preliminary Day One Hundred Thirty Four trial. Lin could invite both adults to the bounded unpowered portion and later spectator place, invite Tan Li alone under a private witness agreement, or keep both sessions closed to ordinary observers while qualified staff performed their roles. The formal teacher's accepted time stayed unchanged. Nobody would see or copy Lin's private root or personal body map. Only the offered stopped apparatus and public task result could be received under the stated conditions.

lark_e17_observers_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_observers_003.text: The open arrangement would let two future readers hear the ordinary source distinctions together. It would also leave more people able to describe a public failed light in their own words. The paired arrangement would give one apprentice time to ask the question she most wanted answered, with no automatic permission to repeat a private witness account publicly. The closed arrangement would keep the practice less exposed and lose both ordinary observers' later firsthand account. Lin could not decide their actual memories after the trial. She could decide which offered places she would permit before it happened.

lark_e17_observers_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_observers_004.text: Tan Li said she wanted to see how a competent person stopped when a visible beginning looked promising. Wu Fang wanted the apparatus headings explained before deciding whether a future ordinary reader might mistake them for a stronger bodily result. Their questions were useful, but neither obliged Lin to offer her own attempt as their lesson. Duan asked what she herself wanted from the room. She knew the answer was not simply privacy or courage. She wanted room to fail and people able to understand a stop, and those desires would not always make the same invitation.

lark_e17_observer_choice.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_observer_choice.text: Lin could invite both Tan Li and Wu Fang to the bounded unpowered lesson and later supervised trial, offer Tan Li one private witness place, or keep ordinary observers outside while qualified staff received their actual work. The public invitation would leave two firsthand accounts and later explanation duties she could accept only within their stated scope. The private place would limit who could use its account. Closing the places would preserve quiet and forgo those independent ordinary memories. No arrangement would qualify a route that had not worked.

choices.text: Invite both ordinary observers under the bounded public scope.
Invite Tan Li as one private witness.
Keep the sessions closed to ordinary observers.

lark_e17_observer_open.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_observer_open.text: Lin invited both ordinary observers under the offered public task scope. Hu Lan read the permission to them before entering their names: stopped apparatus headings and visible task result, with no private root inspection or copied personal body map. The adults accepted their ordinary spectator places and the qualified staff's authority to close them if present conditions changed. Wu Fang checked that his basket work would end before the lesson began. Tan Li arranged her desk relief under its separate employer receiving. Their invitation had to fit actual lives rather than make two convenient witnesses appear without another task displaced.

lark_e17_observer_open_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_observer_open_002.text: Lin also offered one twenty minute public readback on Day One Hundred Forty, if her current ordinary recovery then allowed it. She would explain the visible task and stopped result to these two invited readers, without owing a new demonstration or an indefinite course. The keeper accepted the exact room interval inside its ordinary public schedule. Lin reserved her own unpaid time for that offered account. She could withdraw it under a current care stop with actual notice. The promise made the invitation more useful and gave her a later responsibility the closed arrangement would not create.

lark_e17_observer_open_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_observer_open_003.text: Tan Li thanked her for naming what would not be explained. Wu Fang wanted a clear sentence saying a visible light could still fail its offered control task. Lin agreed to read that sentence at the actual lesson before anybody saw a tempting beginning. She would not let observers discover their permission only when they asked a difficult question afterward. The two adults left with their named places and current limits. The private practice folder stayed in the locked room, while the permitted public invitation went to their actual ordinary receiving addresses.

lark_e17_observer_paired.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_observer_paired.text: Lin offered Tan Li one private witness place. Hu Lan read the bounded permission before accepting it: the apprentice could observe the stopped apparatus explanation and later visible supervised trial, retain her own private memory, and ask one current question inside the offered time. Public repetition of Lin's private witness account would need another permission. No root or personal body map would be opened. Tan Li accepted and arranged her ordinary desk relief separately. Wu Fang received the refusal of his proposed place plainly, with no suggestion that he might appear anyway because he had asked first.

lark_e17_observer_paired_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_observer_paired_002.text: Lin offered Tan Li a single twenty minute private readback on Day One Hundred Thirty Nine if the present ordinary care permitted it then. The keeper found an available lower room inside its ordinary schedule. The interval would explain the actual visible result and the apprentice's one bounded source question, not perform new qi work. Lin accepted that unpaid personal time without a further teacher fee assumed. The appointment belonged to this invitation. Tan Li would not gain a standing claim over every future failure because one current witness place had been offered to her.

lark_e17_observer_paired_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_observer_paired_003.text: Wu Fang was disappointed and said a repair trainee also needed to know where a promising light stopped being proof. Lin directed him to the keeper's public explanation of the offered task without lending her private session to it. He could receive ordinary public material at the regular table. He could not claim he had watched her practice after the closed place had been declined. Lin disliked being the person who limited a useful question. The actual limited permission still mattered. Tan Li left with one accepted place, and Wu with a different source he could actually consult.

lark_e17_observer_closed.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_observer_closed.text: Lin kept both ordinary observer places closed. Qualified staff would still receive their actual teaching and apparatus work; the room was not a secret task she could certify alone. She wanted its present quiet while the ankle and incomplete pair were being tested under limited conditions. Hu Lan gave the two adults that concrete answer without inventing a lack of courage or qualification on either side. The ordinary workers could consult the regular public task explanation at its existing table. They would not later claim a firsthand memory of a session they had been told they could not attend.

lark_e17_observer_closed_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_observer_closed_002.text: Tan Li asked whether Lin would offer a private explanation afterward instead. Lin declined the new appointment for now. She was willing to direct a public source question to the competent keeper, but did not want the closed session to become a delayed personal obligation through a different doorway. The refusal preserved twenty minutes she might otherwise have promised during recovery. It also left the apprentice without the specific current readback she had wanted. A quiet room had a real cost in the conversations it would not produce, even when qualified examination remained available.

lark_e17_observer_closed_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_observer_closed_003.text: Wu Fang said he would use the ordinary public apparatus sheet and see whether its heading answered his question. He accepted the lack of a personal witness invitation without claiming the public sheet was exactly the same thing. Lin appreciated that distinction more than a reassurance that nothing had been lost. She could invite observers at some later actual task if she wanted and current conditions allowed it. Today's refusal stayed today's refusal. The keeper left both spectator lines blank and kept the forthcoming preliminary trial's ordinary receiving with its actual qualified staff.

lark_e17_middle_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_middle_001.text: The next formal meeting took place on Day One Hundred Twenty Two before Lin's separately scheduled ordinary desk work. Duan had her recover the fifth route's fixed references from the stopped diagram, then put the diagram away before the actual small attempt. The third upper limb pair held through its first complete useful quarter within the half input ceiling. The independent ground release received the stop. Ordinary rest followed before a changed order. The second task interrupted early. One complete movement had occurred here. A second failure kept the new route from being accepted as stable under the offered comparison.

lark_e17_middle_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_middle_002.text: The eleventh completed formal meeting received its four copper after instruction, bringing the teaching total to forty four with nine meetings left. Lin then completed the accepted six hour low desk shift at its own ordinary pace and received another four copper. Twenty six personal shifts meant one hundred four earned copper. The two completed scopes had different sources and objects, and the qi work had ended before the desk role began. She went to bed tired in an ordinary way. The ankle did not shorten its turn afterward or change her sleep through hidden swelling.

lark_e17_middle_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_middle_003.text: On the one hundred twenty fifth morning, the current protected practice repeated the fifth task after ordinary recovery. The first and changed order both reached their useful quarters inside the same bounded input and breath count. Duan accepted those current movements as prior practice for the proposed next route, not as a six pair certificate. Lin wanted him to say the fifth was finally hers forever. He asked which future task they had tested forever. She laughed reluctantly and kept the actual two received results. The good day did not need the larger invented promise to remain good.

lark_e17_middle_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_middle_004.text: The following ordinary shift on that day brought her to twenty seven completed shifts and one hundred eight received copper. At its finish, Tan Li asked the competent apparatus keeper for the public heading that distinguished a useful fraction from an illuminated strip. Her observer permission did not answer that question automatically; the regular keeper's source did. Lin heard it from her own drawer and kept working until her actual bell. A student's current progress and an apprentice's ordinary reading could meet in the same room without making either person the other's whole instructor.

lark_e17_lesson_gate.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_lesson_gate.text: On Day One Hundred Twenty Eight, Hu Lan checked the actual invitation before opening the unpowered lesson. Two accepted ordinary observers would receive only their public task scope. One private witness would receive her bounded question time. A closed ordinary session would leave both places empty while qualified staff performed their received roles. Lin did not change the invitation to match her present confidence in the fifth route. The people who had arranged relief or accepted a refusal would find the place they had actually been promised.

lark_e17_lesson_open_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_lesson_open_001.text: Tan Li and Wu Fang arrived at their accepted ordinary spectator places before the unpowered portion began. Hu Lan checked their names and the room's current boundary, then kept the private practice folder closed. Duan demonstrated the stopped task heading with an ordinary pointer and no qi supplied. Wu Fang read useful quarter as if it meant one quarter of whatever light appeared. Tan Li asked which actual output the fraction described. Their disagreement brought the exact mistake into speech before a visible result could make it harder to question.

lark_e17_lesson_open_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_lesson_open_002.text: The keeper showed the separate input and useful task headings on the public sheet. A light could be visible without delivering the offered useful quarter, and a total half input ceiling did not mean another breath could be added to finish it. The adults each read the condition back in their own ordinary words. Lin heard how differently they had first understood the same sentence. Their presence had given the lesson a real reader's question she would otherwise have answered silently for herself. It did not let them qualify her next body movement from a spectator place.

lark_e17_lesson_open_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_lesson_open_003.text: At the unpowered interval's accepted end, both observers left the actual practice space before the private route work began. They retained the permitted public task account and their named later preliminary trial places. Lin had neither exposed her personal root nor borrowed the adults as unpaid operators. Their current ordinary jobs resumed under the relief they had arranged. The forthcoming public readback on Day One Hundred Forty remained conditional on actual ordinary care. Two invited people would now have separate firsthand knowledge of how the trial's offered visible result was supposed to be described.

lark_e17_lesson_paired_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_lesson_paired_001.text: Tan Li entered the one private witness place while Wu Fang remained outside under his actual declined invitation. Hu Lan kept the apprentice's accepted boundary beside the unpowered public sheet, with the personal practice folder closed. Tan Li asked whether a failed visible result meant the teacher had judged the person incapable of learning. Duan said it meant that actual offered task had not received its criterion. A future route would require future work. The question had been about a conclusion the sheet's fractions could never make on their own.

lark_e17_lesson_paired_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_lesson_paired_002.text: Lin said she often heard that larger judgment in her own head before any teacher had spoken it. Tan Li accepted the statement as part of this private witness conversation, without public permission to quote it. The apprentice asked how an ordinary reader could avoid treating an interrupted light as a hidden complete result. The keeper read the useful task condition and independent stop distinctly. Tan Li wrote the public source heading, not Lin's personal answer, on the sheet she was permitted to retain. The room had answered one actual witness's question inside its accepted time.

lark_e17_lesson_paired_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_lesson_paired_003.text: At the private unpowered interval's finish, Tan Li left the body practice space and returned to her ordinary desk work. She retained one named spectator place for the later supervised preliminary trial, no operator authority and no claim over Wu Fang's absent memory. Lin's promised private readback for Day One Hundred Thirty Nine remained limited by actual care then. The private practice folder opened only after the apprentice had left. A quieter invitation had produced one useful conversation and kept its personal words from becoming an ordinary public account anybody could repeat.

lark_e17_lesson_closed_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_lesson_closed_001.text: The two ordinary spectator places stayed empty. Tan Li and Wu Fang were on their own accepted work instead, without a delayed doorway invitation implied. Qualified staff received the formal meeting inside its actual teaching and apparatus roles. Duan read the unpowered public task heading with Lin and asked where a visible beginning might invite an unaccepted extra breath. She pointed to the missing useful output, then admitted her own desire to make the beginning count. The quiet room let her name that impulse without deciding how two ordinary observers would later describe it.

lark_e17_lesson_closed_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_lesson_closed_002.text: Jiang compared the public heading with the currently isolated apparatus stop. Lin could identify the independent release without borrowing a spectator's question as evidence that she understood it. She had chosen fewer ordinary voices in the room, and the qualified source still had to catch her actual mistake. Duan turned the sheet over and asked her to state the ceiling from memory before seeing it again. She gave the half total over four ordinary breaths and the eighth on each, then waited while the actual source was read back. Confidence received comparison rather than applause.

lark_e17_lesson_closed_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_lesson_closed_003.text: The accepted unpowered portion ended without creating a personal public or private readback appointment. The two ordinary workers could use the keeper's existing public explanation on its regular schedule, but they had no firsthand account of this session. Lin kept the closed invitation intact even though the fifth route had begun to work better. A later good result would not authorize an earlier absent witness. The private folder opened for qualified body practice with its actual people present. She had bought no secrecy over their competent records; she had simply kept these ordinary observer places closed.

lark_e17_sixth_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_sixth_001.text: The twelfth formal meeting then turned to the lateral lower limb primary pair. Duan had Lin identify its two fixed references without using the neighboring anterior or posterior route as a convenient continuation. The familiar pair lay close enough in her attention to make the new line seem already finished. She traced its ordinary anatomy on the curriculum diagram first, with no extraordinary bridge or additional dantian invoked. The ankle's present small effort remained inside its current ordinary acceptance. A new primary route would need to work here on its own terms.

lark_e17_sixth_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_sixth_002.text: Her first actual sixth pair attempt ended before the useful task criterion. The connection had begun along the intended primary line, but she tried to keep it moving by shifting the ordinary foot outside its accepted small range. Duan stopped the task, and Jiang received the independent ground release. Lin returned to the chair before trying to describe the failure. The ankle remained comfortable afterward because the actual movement had stopped early. That quiet result mattered. It was not proof that a longer attempt outside the accepted range would also have been safe.

lark_e17_sixth_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_sixth_003.text: They adjusted the ordinary support height rather than add qi input. Lin's next accepted attempt used the same fixed line with the foot remaining inside its range. The useful quarter reached the small talisman within the half ceiling and four ordinary breaths. She grounded and rested, then failed the changed order before its second movement. The sixth had produced one actual bounded task. It had not become repeatable merely because the first success made her feel she had found its secret. Duan entered both current outcomes and asked which one she most wanted to omit.

lark_e17_sixth_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_sixth_004.text: Lin said she wanted the notebook to be shorter. Duan said that was an ordinary wish after a long morning and left both lines there. The twelfth formal meeting received its four copper, bringing teaching payments to forty eight and leaving eight meetings. Another two copper accepted practice fuel purchase brought the paid external packs to eight of twenty four. The measuring work remained a current apparatus record, with no bought pack counted as Lin's recovered personal reserve. She ate the provider's ordinary meal and rested before the accepted desk shift began.

lark_e17_sixth_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_sixth_005.text: The Day One Hundred Twenty Eight ordinary six hour shift received its own four copper, making twenty eight completed shifts and one hundred twelve earned copper. Lin kept the current body task finished and grounded before handling its public papers. She was not permitted to sustain the new route through her ordinary work just to become accustomed to it faster. The receiver had bought source comparison inside her present handling limit. She could finish that real scope while the practice notebook still held one sixth pair task and one changed order failure.

lark_e17_sixth_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_sixth_006.text: On Day One Hundred Thirty, the next permitted recovered practice repeated the lateral lower limb task with the corrected ordinary support. The first, reversed and changed permitted orders each reached the small useful criterion under their unchanged ceiling. The independent stop and grounded release remained competent received parts of every attempt. Lin rested between them and checked the ordinary foot's turn afterward instead of leaning on a proud new route to hide it. The sixth pair had become usable in these actual prior tasks. A broader local qualification still required reserve, compatibility, control and recovered later days.

lark_e17_sixth_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_sixth_007.text: Duan asked her to name the complete primary set before the final prior comparison. She gave the two established arm pairs, the third upper limb primary pair, and the anterior, posterior and lateral lower limb pairs, each by its fixed trunk reference. The list left governing and conception extraordinary links unopened. She could say six without imagining a new chamber above the lower dantian. The route names described actual prior practice rather than a future power claim. Jiang kept the small talisman isolated from every mechanical load so the comparison would ask that bounded question clearly.

lark_e17_sixth_008.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_sixth_008.text: Lin completed the next six hour desk shift on Day One Hundred Thirty One, earning four and bringing her to twenty nine completed shifts and one hundred sixteen copper. That ordinary day did not give the course another formal meeting or certify the practice. She slept without changed ankle swelling and returned to the room under the same current small effort plan. The absence of a symptom supplied one useful present observation. It did not erase the requirement to stop if the next task changed it. She had become better at hearing that conditional without treating it as a threat.

lark_e17_sixth_009.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_sixth_009.text: The thirteenth formal meeting began on Day One Hundred Thirty Three with a fresh isolated bed check and ordinary movement observation. Lin used the established four in the changed order, then the separately learned fifth and sixth in their accepted small tasks. Their useful quarters reached the criterion without extending the half input or four breath ceiling. She let the independent release finish after each, with ordinary rest before the next route. Duan received the actual six prior movements and the interruptions together. A current completed set could be true without deleting the failures through which it had been learned.

lark_exam_prior_practice.speaker: narrator
lark_exam_prior_practice.text: The qualified prior practice receiving named all six distinct primary pairs, each actually used in its bounded changed order task with an independent stop, grounded release and recovered interval. Lin had performed the two established arm, third upper limb, anterior, posterior and lateral lower limb routes here. No governing or conception bridge, extra dantian, flight or healed limb had been supplied. This receiving admitted her to the preliminary control check. It did not certify the sixth stage. The local forty eight usable and ninety percent comparison, three later trials and recovered next mornings remained unperformed.

lark_e17_after_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_after_001.text: The thirteenth completed formal meeting received another four copper, bringing actual teaching payments to fifty two of eighty with seven meetings left. The keeper bought a further accepted two copper practice pack, making ten of the twenty four fuel budget used. The actual external charge remained the apparatus's source, separately measured from the lower dantian reserve Lin would have sampled for a local trial. Neither a fuller fuel jar nor a complete prior route list answered that later comparison. She put the teacher's current receiving beside the packet the preliminary checker would actually read.

lark_e17_after_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_after_002.text: The next morning's offered check would test changed control after recovered ordinary activity and sleep, with current sampling consumed before usable reserve was recorded. The local new forty eight and ninety percent criteria had been preregistered before this training. They were conditions for this qualified course's comparison, not a universal numerical description of every cultivator called sixth stage elsewhere. Duan wanted the actual task to meet them here rather than a student borrow a famous name as proof. Lin had agreed while the numbers were still distant. The nearer trial made their separate plain meaning harder to welcome.

lark_e17_after_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_after_003.text: Her current record still named the fifth stage. Opening two further primary routes in prior practice had made a real difference to what she could attempt under supervision. It had not completed the later control sequence, received independent trials, or demonstrated recovered next mornings. Lin copied the preliminary time and its ordinary sleep condition without writing a congratulatory page beneath it. She could hope for a good task tomorrow. She did not have to announce herself already qualified to make that hope serious. The notebook contained a beginning with work behind it and actual questions still ahead.

lark_e17_after_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_after_004.text: Qin found her outside the lower room after the formal receiving and offered a short ordinary walk to the market wall. It lay inside her currently accepted distance and neither of them took the stair toward the old gallery. He had stopped feeling a need to show her every changed timber. She had stopped making every visible joint a lesson. They reached the wall and watched a goat pull loose grain from a seller's basket. The seller shouted at the owner, who shouted at the goat. Their three different arguments supplied no cultivation question anybody needed to resolve.

lark_e17_after_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_after_005.text: The goat's owner insisted it had never stolen before. Qin asked how far that account extended beyond the journeys on which he had actually watched it. The owner called him an unhelpful porter and took the animal away. Lin laughed until her ordinary breath shortened, then settled before going back. A clever source question could be true and poorly timed. Qin said he would remember that the next time a supplier asked why a basket had returned cracked. Lin thought the question deserved better than being put away simply because it had once made a goat's owner angry.

lark_e17_after_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_after_006.text: At the lower stall, she looked at the carved needle case she had declined earlier. Its lid now carried a tiny bridge with an absurdly high flag. The seller had seen Qin Yi's new drawing and asked the family's permission to use only the public ordinary crossing idea, not its particular page. Lin admired the crooked flag and bought nothing. Her present purse had paid the added assessment, and its road use still mattered. She could enjoy a beautiful small object without treating a successful prior practice as money earned for that purchase.

lark_e17_after_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_after_007.text: The seller asked whether she would certainly qualify tomorrow. Lin said the offered preliminary task would answer its current question after it occurred. He called that a disappointing prediction. She agreed that certainty would have been more entertaining. He turned the case so she could see the unpainted underside and said it was not finished either. The ordinary admission made the conversation easier. They could both have good work partly done without needing the other's assurance that the last part would arrive exactly as hoped.

lark_e17_after_008.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_after_008.text: Shan Fang served the evening household story at Lin's lodging doorway because the provider's ordinary meal had already been received. She brought no second unbudgeted feast. Qin Yi had made the goat from her earlier play refuse to cross the tiny bridge until the flag was lowered. Its reason was not safety; the goat disliked the flag's shadow. Shan asked whether that distinction could be heard in the child's story. The child tried the scene again. Lin enjoyed an ordinary character allowed a preference rather than an explanation that made every complaint sound necessary.

lark_e17_after_009.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_after_009.text: The new scene needed a longer pause than the family's old performance. Qin Yi wanted Lin to count its four ordinary breaths, then asked whether those were the same as her practice breaths. Lin said ordinary breaths could be counted in many tasks, but the play was not using qi or receiving a talisman. The child looked disappointed and then grateful that the goat could pause a fifth breath if its joke needed one. A learned limit could remain real in its own work without becoming a rule every ordinary story had to obey.

lark_e17_after_010.speaker: narrator
lark_e17_after_010.text: After the visitors left, Lin checked the ankle in the current ordinary movement she had actually been permitted.
